requirements.title: INQUIRE forms may observe files, units, or output-list storage requirements
requirements.definition: The INQUIRE statement can be used in three forms: inquire by file with FILE=, inquire by unit with UNIT= or positional file-unit-number, and inquire by output list with only IOLENGTH=.

pending.inquire-by-file-form: Positive-control source uses INQUIRE(FILE=name, EXIST=flag) after creating a named file; flag is initialized to .false. and is expected true by 12.10.2.11.
pending.inquire-by-unit-form: Positive-control source opens a known external unit, initializes OPENED to .false., and uses INQUIRE(UNIT=unit, OPENED=opened), expecting true by 12.10.2.20.
pending.inquire-by-output-list-form: Future 12.10.3 fixture initializes an integer IOLENGTH variable to -777 and executes INQUIRE(IOLENGTH=iol) on a nonempty list; only positivity/suitability fixed by 12.10.3 is asserted.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive INQUIRE plans first establish the connection or file state being observed, initialize every inquiry variable to a nonmatching sentinel value, execute INQUIRE, and assert only values fixed by 12.10.2: exact tokens such as UNDEFINED or UNKNOWN, logical true/false where specified, zero/nonzero IOSTAT where 12.11 later permits it, or bounded set membership where the source gives a set. Processor-dependent file names, case interpretation, multi-unit choices, file storage unit counts, asynchronous completion policy, IOMSG text, and numeric status codes are not asserted.

requirements.title: INQUIRE assignments use intrinsic-assignment conversion, truncation, and padding
requirements.definition: Assignments to variables named in INQUIRE specifiers are converted, truncated, or padded according to intrinsic assignment rules.

pending.inquire-character-padding: Use a character inquiry variable longer than the token, prefilled with sentinels, and assert the token plus intrinsic-assignment blank padding, not unchanged sentinel bytes.
pending.inquire-character-truncation: Use a shorter character variable for a token with a unique prefix after a connection that fixes the token; assert only intrinsic-assignment truncation of that fixed token.
pending.inquire-numeric-logical-assignment: Use integer/logical specifier variables initialized to nondefault sentinels and assert exact fixed values such as NUMBER=-1 or OPENED=.true. after establishing the required state.

requirements.title: INQUIRE may be executed before, during, or after connection
requirements.definition: An INQUIRE statement may be executed before, while, or after a file is connected to a unit.

pending.inquire-before-connection: Before opening a suite-generated filename, prefill EXIST/OPENED with opposite sentinels and expect EXIST=.false., OPENED=.false. after verifying the file is absent.
pending.inquire-during-connection: While a named file is open on one unit, prefill OPENED and NUMBER sentinels and expect OPENED=.true. and the known unit number.
pending.inquire-after-connection: After closing a previously connected named file with STATUS="KEEP", prefill EXIST=.false. and OPENED=.true.; expect EXIST=.true. and OPENED=.false.

accounting.rationale: Mixed form permissions and intrinsic-assignment effects are split.
Permission for unconnected/nonexistent units is split from connected-unit subject semantics.
Permission for nonexistent/unconnected files is split from connected-file subject semantics.
Execution-time permission is split from current-value requirement.

review_rationale: Source registration for 12.10, the INQUIRE statement and all thirty-four inquiry specifiers (batch165). Every unit hash-verified by independent reviewers across three rounds. Round 1 split the 'unable to determine' latitude out of eight YES/NO/UNKNOWN specifiers and out of ENCODING and SIZE; round 2 made the plans assert only what that latitude leaves portable - membership in {YES, UNKNOWN} for a method in use, and {POS-1, -1} for the size of a stream file. R1230, R1231 and C1247-C1251 were pre-accounted. With this packet Clause 12 is fully registered. Source accounting only.
